text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Nigeria Airways may have traded off some of its assets to recover a plane seized last month by a British finance company. The creditors apparently advised the company to part with three aircraft engines which were in Belgium.
- Members of the "Vision 2010" committee divide up into groups to discuss different areas of the long term economic strategty.
- Aviation Development Company resumes flights after November Boeing 727 crash in which 142 people died.
- Almost 3,000 postal workers may have lost their jobs in a major rationalisation exercise.
- Nigerian Bottling Company cuts prices of Coke and Fanta from 15 naira to 12 naira a bottle in the face of declining purchasing power and severe competition.
